Do you want to work in a modern metal company in Bergeijk where you stay active and do hands-on work with great colleagues? Then this role is for you! 
 Over het werk 
For a modern metal company in Bergeijk, we are looking for a production employee who enjoys working with their hands and likes technical work in a production environment. 
As a production employee, you will work with modern machines and be involved in making and finishing metal parts. The work is varied, and no two days are the same. 
 Wat wij bieden 
 - Full-time day shift job from 07:30 to 16:30 and on Fridays, you finish at 14:30 - Competitive salary depending on your experience and skills - Working with modern systems and equipment - Free gym membership - Pleasant and informal working atmosphere 
 Wat wij vragen 
 - Someone who enjoys practical and technical work - Able to work accurately and has an eye for quality - Willing to learn how to use measuring tools - Team player who likes to get things done - Speaks Dutch or English 
 Over het bedrijf 
The company is a growing and innovative organization where craftsmanship and teamwork are key. There is strong focus on developing employees, and the working atmosphere is open and pleasant, where your ideas and effort are truly valued. 
You will work together with enthusiastic colleagues on challenging projects and get the space to further develop yourself. Professionalism and quality always come first, with short communication lines and an informal culture.
